marker.category: screen recorder that makes zoomed demo videos

fails.msg: its content fills 38% of its screen; merge it or give it its visual (0.55 is the aim)
fails.fix: fill the section or make it a screen shorter

fails.msg: 1753px, 2.08 screens; a section is exactly one or two (--h), or on a phone at least one that its content fills
fails.fix: make the section exactly one or two screens (--h: 1 or 2)

warns.where: section#features "What zoomies does to a recording. It all"
warns.msg: a section over 1.5 screens long with no link or button in it
warns.fix: add the action: a button in the hero, one on every priced item, one in the closing section

warns.msg: "Nothing leaves the tab" names no product, part, place or section (the one brand line a page may have)
warns.fix: name the thing in every heading: the product, a part, the place or a section noun

warns.msg: 1 line of text in drawn mocks read under 4.5:1 (1 colour pair), the worst "Delete" in #c2341b on #111110 at 3.42:1
warns.fix: lift the mocks' muted text (labels, meta, initials) to 4.5:1 on their own panel, or set it larger

warns.msg: uneven space at the edge of a band: 71px outside its edge, 115px inside it (the space on either side of a change of ground reads as one gap only when the two match)
warns.fix: use one gap between sections (all within 25% of each other)

warns.msg: "zoomies" opens a section headed "Screen recorder that zooms in for you"
warns.fix: name each nav link after the heading of the section it opens

warns.msg: "Editor" opens a section headed "Every zoom in the demo video, on one timeline"
warns.fix: name each nav link after the heading of the section it opens

warns.msg: "Features" opens a section headed "What zoomies does to a recording. It all runs in t"
warns.fix: name each nav link after the heading of the section it opens

warns.msg: 1 section over 90 words a screen outside the UI mocks ("Questions" 169); 65 words a screen across the page (452 words in 7 screens): a tech page says it in about 80 or fewer
warns.fix: cut every section to its heading, one line and the product UI: the UI says the rest; no second paragraph, no list of feature sentences

warns.msg: the nav stays on screen with 4 links to the page's sections, but never marks the one you are in (no link changes as the page scrolls)
warns.fix: mark the link of the section on screen (a colour, a weight or a line under it) as the visitor scrolls

warns.where: div.hero-text > div.hero__c > div.btn-row > a.btn.btn--secondary "Read the source"
warns.msg: the button "Read the source" (#1f1f1e) stands only 1.15:1 off the ground around it: it reads as part of the ground, or as switched off
warns.fix: give the button a fill that stands at least 1.5:1 off what is around it, or an outline in the ink

warns.where: div.ui.app > div.app__pane.ze__main > div.ze__transport > span.ze__hint "Click the preview to aim a zoom"
warns.msg: a muted 13px line of 1 row sits 19px under the canvas: it reads as a caption: "Click the preview to aim a zoom"; no caption or description under any image, render or visual (house rule)
warns.fix: take the line away: no caption or description under, over or on any image, render or visual; a licence credit goes in one footer line

warns.msg: particle code or heavy canvas 2D drawing on a software page (700 shapes a second): check it is a deliberate scene
warns.fix: keep particles to the one big scene, or take them off

warns.where: header.nav.nav--centre > div.wrap.nav__bar > div.nav__actions > a.btn.btn--primary "record a demo"
warns.msg: "record a demo" shows 2 times on the first screen at 1440px (nav, hero): the nav's button and the hero's; nothing else on the screen may repeat it
warns.fix: show the action once a screen besides the nav's button: the hero's, the close's or the phone bar's, never all at once

warns.where: section#features "What zoomies does to a recording. It all"
warns.msg: screen group 2 of this two-screen section fills 35.5% of a screen: 40% or more (25% WARN) (SR-3)
warns.fix: fill the section to 55%: more content, a picture or a background layer, or merge it into the section above as its last block

warns.msg: the nav is lopsided: its last item ends 13px inside the content's edge (366px), while its first starts on the other edge
warns.fix: start the nav's first item and end its last on the content's two edges

warns.msg: a muted 12px line of 1 row sits 20px under the canvas: it reads as a caption: "0:02 / 0:07"; no caption or description under any image, render or visual (house rule)
warns.fix: take the line away: no caption or description under, over or on any image, render or visual; a licence credit goes in one footer line
